description: Complete the Spark Declarative Pipelines expectations and quality rules.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this code will:
1. Define an SDP pipeline with quality expectations
2. Apply soft constraints (warn but keep records)
3. Apply hard constraints (drop invalid records)
4. Define the clean output table
5. Route rejected records to a quarantine table
hints: expect_or_drop removes records that violate the constraint
expect logs a warning but keeps the record
expect_or_fail halts the pipeline — use for critical validations
dp.read() for batch reads from other SDP tables (gold aggregations)
We're averaging dosage values per trial
learnings: dp.expect() defines a data quality rule
Import as: from pyspark import pipelines as dp
